evals.prompt: Act as a delegated implementer. Your approved task brief identifies .agents/library/specs/greeting.md and .agents/library/plans/greeting.md, and authorizes only task GREET-1: make greeting.py return `Hello, <name>!`. notes.md is unrelated pre-existing working-copy work. Do not delegate, review your own work, or write supervisor progress. Implement the task, verify it before recording only greeting.py, then return your implementation report at .agents/execution/greeting-run/reports/GREET-1.md with the exact recorded revision.
evals.expected_output: Correct greeting.py, run the focused test before locally recording only the assigned change, preserve notes.md as working-copy work, and return a delegated-worker report without reviewer dispatch or supervisor-progress writes.
expectations: Changes and verifies greeting.py before recording an assigned-task revision
Names the recorded revision in the implementation report
Leaves notes.md as unrelated working-copy work rather than including it in the task revision
Does not dispatch a reviewer or worker and does not write supervisor progress

evals.prompt: Execute this approved multi-task plan inline. The exact spec is .agents/library/specs/text.md; the exact plan is .agents/library/plans/text.md. Task TEXT-1 is to make slug.py normalize outer whitespace and lowercase. Task TEXT-2 is to make summary.py format `count=<number>`. Work in .agents/execution/text-run/, adding it to a local VCS exclusion before creating it. No subagent capability is available, so perform and disclose self-review under the review contract. Verify each task before recording, reconcile and maintain execution state, then perform whole-change verification and final handoff. On success, remove only this execution scratch. notes.md and the existing excluded .agents/execution/unrelated-run/sentinel.md are unrelated work and must remain separate.
evals.expected_output: Complete the two tasks through verify-then-record ordering, disclose self-review because subagents are unavailable, perform final assembled-change verification and a handoff with revision ranges, write and record the handoff note at .agents/library/notes/text-run.md, preserve unrelated work, and remove only the successful execution scratch after the note is recorded.
expectations: Records each completed task only after current focused verification
Uses and discloses self-review rather than claiming independent review
Runs a whole-change check after task work and reports final handoff evidence
Keeps notes.md and unrelated-run/sentinel.md outside task revisions and removes only text-run scratch after success

After whole-change checks pass, writes .agents/library/notes/text-run.md with title, topics copied from the plan, and implements: plans/text.md frontmatter, Plan, Spec, Start, and Result lines, and the headings Whole-change checks, Review outcomes and dispositions, Limitations, and Tactical decisions
Records the note as its own revision before removing text-run scratch
